resources.string: Lets the subtitles hear the microphone during speakerphone calls (WhatsApp, Zoom, Meet…).

During a call Android gives the microphone only to the call app; the subtitle app receives silence. While this service is on, MED LIVE TRANSLATE can hear the microphone during calls too and make subtitles.
This service does not read anything on your screen, does not watch your touches and performs no actions. Sound is transcribed only on the phone.
